01723 Dehaye' (亞蘭文) {de-ha:-ye:'}

字源不詳; 專有名詞 種族名稱

欽定本 - Dehavites 1; 1

底亥人 = "體弱多病的"
1) 種族名稱 (#拉 4:9|)
2) 另有一種讀法, 源自 01768 01932, 將該字視為連接詞"亦即"

of uncertain derivation;; n pr

AV - Dehavites 1; 1

Dehavites = "the sickly"
1) the name of a people
           or
2) that is, which is to say (simple particles)
